notes.title: The recasted version is live
notes.notes:
We are so happy to announce that the recasted version of Drifter’s Tales is available.

How to play?

You should be able to see an update for your game starting now. Everything should be automatic on Steam, you just have to play!

What’s next?

As mentioned before, we are already working on a DLC and porting the game on other platforms. The DLC will be free for those who bought the game before the update.

notes.title: Discover the new features of the recasted version
notes.notes:
Along with the demo we released a few days back, we prepared you a short video presenting you all the changes to come in the recasted version.

[previewyoutube=yNadvfCmThc;full][/previewyoutube]

As a reminder, here's a list of those changes:

A brand-new story

You will be able to try a brand-new story, which will take you to the continent of Carmina, full of legends and threats. During your playthrough, you will have to choose your own path to your main objective. We are not sharing many details about the story, but we are excited about this one!

Know that one playthrough won't be enough to discover all the stories - some will be available according your choices, and all of them will change on the NG+. Ah yes, a NG+ mode is fully integrated in the recasted version.

New gameplay

In the initial version, you must pick from a card to another to move around. In the recasted version, you will be able to move a pawn on a map and pick the card you want to. It will allow you to move around quickly and not waste time on cards you already have read.

The battles were also fully rebranded. We increased the readability of them, allowing you to move the point of view on the game board. Plus, some enemy moves require you to avoid projectiles and draw rune to test your reflexes and dexterity.

New cards, new ways to obtain them

30+ new cards. Not less! You character will be able to create new cards at the end of each story and will have to remember some lost memories to unlock more cards.

We have added more cards in the chests and more random encounters and each story has a secret card you will have to discover.

Finally, some cards will be hidden behind legends to read on the story selection screen. These cards are powerful and will change your build if you find them!

New customization features

We are also proposing you to customize your player cards by increasing their stats. Those customizations will be available with a new character, the "Alchemist". He will help you to create potions from some ingredients you could loot around.

Economy balancing

Finally, we have balanced the economy. Thanks to this balancing, you can buy more cards and build a real deck for breaking your enemies. And if you run out of gems... you can destroy some cards to earn some more.

Quality of life improvements

We integrated too some QOL improvements in the recasted version:
- full mouse / keyboard / gamepad support without choosing a mode
- battles / exploration / return to checkpoints without any loading
- file-based save system for the masters who want to edit their saves
- mods support
- performances improvements

notes.title: A short playable preview will come in an update on 27th March
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that you will be able to try the features of the recasted version of Drifter’s Tales in an upcoming prologue.

Explore the very first level of the game - which won’t be the first to play

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/cae880ec9c923c1a45fd7c5efccba35522068841.png

The prologue will take you in an area you already saw on other marketing materials and trailers. In this prologue, you will be able to do all the things you will normally do in a playthrough of the recasted version, such as trading, exploring, opening chests, finding encounters, etc. We also integrated a battle that will allow you to test the fresh-looted cards you had.

Your character will have more gems to allow you to buy more cards and try some deck builds.

The documentary

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/9a0206e2d3d15c1c9c4255f8154e6df648800b77.png

Because this is more than “a story” you can try, we integrated in the prologue some developers' comments about how & why we made the recasted version. People interested in how indie developers are making games would be interested in that documentary, full of archives from our Game Design Document and early prototypes.

How to launch the prologue & limitations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/8d0ed1ab5a8002656228b08f03963629258d9a07.png
After updating your game on Steam through the usual process, you will see a new button in the game title screen labelled “Play to Recasted: Prologue”. Choosing this action will launch the standalone prologue level through a new process and close the legacy game automatically.

If the prologue cannot be launched (some configurations can prevent a game to launch another .exe file), you can find it under [your-game-directory]/prologue/drifters_tales.exe

You will also have some limitations due to the standalone nature of the prologue:

 No options (language, sound, graphics)
 The language will be selected automatically according to your system configuration
 No save data
 You won’t have access to 29 cards: the ones given at the end of a level, the enhanced versions of the starting cards, the cards obtained with The Storyteller and the advanced cards of the origins.


What’s next?

After the prologue, we will continue the development of the recasted version as we had to before Steam decided to delete our game page. We will also continue to polish the demo we had to release during the Steam Next Fest and release it on early June as announced previously.

We are so closed to the end of the development of the recasted version! As we are writing those lines, we finished 3/4 of the production of the game, and we will go to the post-production polish end of May.

We will continue to post updates to keep you informed about our progresses.

Cheers!

Teddy

notes.title: Dev diary #5: Alpha post-mortem, upcoming changes & Steam page
notes.notes:
We launched our alpha version a few weeks ago and we already have a lot of interesting feedback on how our players have used our game.

If you would like to participate, you can register here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaYRR1KQjarm1cZcuW6aHoCTA66PnAy1xuV-E9AWdCcht8tQ/viewform?usp=sf_link

Oh, and also we finally have our Steam page for our game! We will tell you a little more about it at the end of the article if you wish to wishlist us.

Some metrics, and what they mean

In order to share with you the work we have done during these few weeks of watching you play, we have decided to share with you some metrics that we consider interesting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/75ef93dbf2bbdbc074a8a7e93bfe7ed3c32b049a.png

The first metric is the usage of stories in this alpha release. The first story to be chosen is undoubtedly the one called “Following the Footsteps”. We don't know (yet) if the main reason is that the button to choose this story is the first one, or if the story has a more welcoming title.

Also, the abandonment rate of stories after a failure is very low (around 11%), which is a good indicator for us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/94c2a6a6a4bd8309ee9c7819d1338a24ef8982dd.png

The second important metric is on the use of the cards while battling. Unsurprisingly, creatures are the most used (because they are the most offensive), but a few secret cards were used (Gargoyle, The Wall and Break).

Also, spells and items are being used correctly, and we're very happy with how the fights are going.

Changes to the game

We're going to do some small changes to the game in the coming weeks, based on your feedback and what we've noticed in your playing habits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/9c048621340085554b27037e9a66dee829d301c0.png

First, we are going to shuffle the order of the buttons while selecting a story. Thus, we will see if the discrepancy between the stories played is due to the position of the button, or to the title of the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/3cc7cebd9ccfcfbbc7d5ddbe99862b333ae96c10.png

Then it occurred to us that the puzzles on the chests were too complicated and required knowledge of the game that new players don't have. We will therefore simplify them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/561bb0f65950e0008a865ae5764451f04f6a74dc.png

Also, we had a new review in the original game which we found to be very interesting. Enemy actions are not legible enough if they have a lot of text. We will therefore make the validation of these actions mandatory when they are presented to you for the first time.

We are on Steam!

And yes, we have - finally - our Steam page! You can find all the necessary information there and wishlist us at this address: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366490/DRIFTERS_TALES__A_narrative_board_game/

We are going to participate in the Steam Next Fest next October!

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
This update contains fixes to issues that we have identified through analysis of in-game telemetry data sent during your games. They also respond to the problems encountered by some of you reported in the comments you submitted to us.

New features :


 Manastones have been separated into 3 different types and restored cards return to your hand instead of your deck.
 A new character allows you to create cards you already have in your possession
 11 new cards: Monstrous Portal, Duplication, Echo of Insane, Break, Weakness, Blue Mana Stone, Red Mana Stone, Yellow Mana Stone, Blue Concentrated Mana Stone, Red Concentrated Mana Stone, Yellow Concentrated Mana Stone
 Randomly in your story, an event can now occur that changes the map you are on
 Some cards will allow you to save your progress internal to the current story


Improvements:


 Better support for all screen resolutions
 The display of the command to exclude cards on the selection of stories has been highlighted
 The defense of some enemies has been reduced in The Village story
 Sellers were added in the last story
 Added feedback when purchasing items
 Game economy rebalancing
 The illustrations of Buffoon and Gargoyle have been revised
 Zoom on cards in the menu & choice to exclude cards has been revised
 Transition speed when a card is chosen while exploring has been increased
 Bets have been raised on all stories
 The last story is no longer played automatically
 Reward display size has been increased
 Breaking an oath no longer removes gems


Fixed issues:


 Fixed a display defect on player levels in the menu
 Zooming on maps did not work when no map could be selected
 Cards won at the end of a story are more readable
 There were still keys not mapped to the chosen device in the tutorials
 Menu context button was not clickable under certain conditions

notes.title: About the november 3 update
notes.notes:
The November update is fast approaching, and now we can tell you more. Discover new cards and new ways to customize your deck.

New UI on card exclusion

By studying the telemetry data, it appeared to us that the exclusion of cards - which is a feature requested by most of you - is rarely used. We have therefore chosen to highlight it more when selecting stories.

Also, the very last story will no longer play automatically, allowing you to exclude cards from your deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/edbf3e4fe25b0bca3fbe234ab7ae2e32d9729eba.png

New cards and a valuation of mana stones

We also noticed that the mana stones were not used very much. Blame it on a hazardous object, whose usefulness comes down to having more cards in the deck at the end of a story.

Thus, we decided to modify this object. There are now 3 types of stones, each of which can move a card from your discard pile directly into your hand (and no longer into the deck). During the tests of this functionality, it appeared that this novelty also increased the synergies between the cards and greatly facilitated the understanding of this object.

Finally, new cards will appear, allowing you - among other things - to directly duplicate cards on the board, modify the statistics of enemies or even give you the possibility of placing more than one card per turn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/b743f4e764177d8424583a2294b808b6197216b6.png

Buy cards you already have

Always with the aim of providing you with a complete card game experience, we have added a new character that allows you to buy cards that have already been acquired. This character will offer you 6 cards for sale each time you talk to him. To make it easier for you, we have rebalanced the whole economy of the game. So you will have more gems to buy these cards and also buy upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/cf51c24968a4e4df6494bbb0d9537f135954ed45.png

Do not restart a story from the beginning

Still studying the telemetry data, we realized that a large number of players left the game after a failure. We have therefore added checkpoints in each story, allowing you to no longer start from the beginning with each failure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/6e1a6d0d0802cf0622bd98559116510472f16e2b.png

Random events to surprise you

This update contains some random events. These events will allow you to have new cards, always serving the narrative. These encounters will not be visible while exploring and will trigger automatically when you go to certain cards. We don't want to reveal too much, but each encounter has a price to pay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/47b825fe6055823d4ca4410630bcc45352382a66.png

...and many other quality of life improvements

And that's not all. We're also going to include a lot of quality of life improvements on this update, here's a quick snippet:

 Better support for all screen resolutions
 The defense of some enemies has been reduced in The Village story
 Sellers were added in the last story
 Added feedback when purchasing items
 The illustrations of Jester and Gargoyle have been revamped
 Zoom on cards in the menu & the exclusion screen have been increased
 The transition speed when a card is chosen while exploring has been increased
 Bets have been raised on all stories


And then?

From now on I will use the pronoun "I", and no longer "we". Because indeed, I am the only developer on this game.

I've been in a period of intense development for 14 weeks, and I'm starting to tire. The Switch port also requires a lot of effort from me and I think it's time for me to rest and watch what happens for the December update.

I tried to offer you the best possible game with my means, and the effort / positive impact ratio is currently too low to continue to include new features. The December update will therefore only offer bug fixes.

Drifter's Tales was launched too soon, that's a fact. However, the free early access phase showed us that the game was ready given the quality of the feedback you posted. The ball is now in your court: if you appreciate the efforts I put into this game, I invite you to talk about it around you to encourage this long-term project.

Teddy

notes.title: A preview for the update #4
notes.notes:
We have analyzed the telemetry data sent during your games and we have been able to determine a few features that will solve problems that we have identified.

This update will be released on November 3.

Highlighting Mana Stones

It occurred to us that mana stones were often left out of decks and not used. We have decided to separate this object into 3 distinct objects which will allow you to restore a particular type of card from your discard pile to your hand (and no longer to your deck as initially).

Always more customization

Also, a new character will appear. For a few gems, it will give you the opportunity to create cards that you already have in your possession.

New cards

Three new cards available in Random Events will appear: Monstrous Portal, Duplicate & Echo of Insane.

Minor quality of life improvements

We are also going to offer you some minor improvements, such as highlighting the command to exclude cards from your deck, rebalancing certain enemies and the game economy.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
This update contains an update to the game engine as well as support for the most popular gamepads.

Also, this update prepares the game for a port on Nintendo Switch which will be out in the coming weeks.

New features:


 Support for XBox, Switch & Dual Shock controllers


Improvements:


 Global engine update
 Improved tutorials with the display of keys depending on the control mode used


Fixed issues:


 Fixed a bug with the Burden Earth capacity that could block an opponent's turn

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
We have heard your feedback and we are bringing you this update which contains many quality of life improvements.

We have also added cards and mods that you can obtain randomly during your exploration to vary your game strategies. Finally, always with the aim of highlighting card mechanics, you can exclude cards from your deck when selecting a story.

New features:


 You can now exclude cards on the story selection screen to help you build your deck
 Six new playing cards: Replacement, Souls of a Sacrificed Hunter, Gargoyle, Banner of Shadows, Jester, Fire
 Two new modifiers: Aura, Burden Earth
 Chests are now available when exploring. These chests will randomly drop a card or modifier.


Improvements:


 Choosing between mouse and keyboard control is now mandatory
 You can now leave a game on the story selection screen
 During exploration, possible movements are highlighted with feedback with mouse control
 Additional feedbacks are present during fights with mouse control
 Cards already visited are no longer animated even if the texts have been updated


Problems fixed:


 Some sentences in French have been correctly translated into English
 Some translations were not available and have been added
 Sometimes the discard selection indicator was not displayed even though it was selectable
 Each time the collection was displayed the cards were multiplied
 Changed stats when viewing card information could has negative values
 Improved click areas on end of story buttons

notes.title: The upcoming update on september 23
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedbacks, and here's a quick preview of the next update coming out on September 23rd.

Mouse support improvements

It seems that the mouse control option is not visible enough for a lot of you. Thus, we made the choice to make this option mandatory, just like the selection of the language.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/20d4b32febe9b283a306a5bec5f2b233f26afdb3.png

Also, feedback will be added to show you more clearly the different possibilities available to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/bb4fdf927fdfce44ef4f926e57fb6ad3857de6d1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/0ed47dc39e4c8fdc4a9409aaf71d1ce109495142.png

Highlighting cards

We were told that the "card game" dimension was also not present enough. Thus, you will soon be able to exclude cards from your deck to perfect your strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/f80f7a33a9c92dfde046fb813f780d10658bcebc.png

Other cards will also appear to vary the gameplay options. These cards will be randomly assigned to available chests during your explorations and will be added to your deck immediately.

Six cards will be added to the pool, and here are some of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/fa23423d0c7991d170c8055f42727b80cdab2b0a.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/65476af45a6ca82a6a39cf6a5a203a58c2a63413.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167009/cb9c94459f24da86b966c407eb5f84f93dbc3bde.png

notes.title: Preview of the next update
notes.notes:
We've received a lot of feedback on Steam reviews and we've been thinking about some improvements we can do to the game:


 First of all, it seems that the mouse control in the options is not visible enough. Thus, we decided to highlight this option by making it mandatory when launching the game for the first time - just like the choice of language.
 Next, mouse support will be improved with more feedbacks: indicators will follow the mouse and the cards outlines will be animated when the player hovers their mouse over them.
 Finally, you will be able to customize your deck by excluding cards when choosing stories in order to highlight the "card game" dimension - because The First Spine is above all a card game.


We hope that this next update, which will be released on September 23, will allow you to make the most of the experience we want to offer you.

Teddy
